method: Each nonblank line is a pattern, except lines whose first character is #, which are comments. Trailing spaces are dropped unless escaped with a backslash, and a leading ! negates the pattern. A pattern with a slash anywhere except a trailing one is anchored to the .gitignore directory; a pattern without a slash matches a path component at any depth. A trailing slash restricts the pattern to directories, and a pattern that matches a directory also excludes everything below it. Wildcards never cross a slash: * matches any run of characters except /, ? matches one such character, and [...] is a character class supporting ranges and ! or ^ negation. A leading **/ matches at any depth, a trailing /** matches everything inside the directory, and /**/ matches zero or more directories; consecutive asterisks anywhere else behave like a single *. The last matching pattern decides the outcome, so a later ! rule re-includes a path; however a path is still ignored when any parent directory is excluded, because the parent-exclusion rule prevents re-inclusion below it. Paths are interpreted relative to the .gitignore directory: a leading slash or ./ is removed, repeated slashes collapse, .. segments are refused, and a trailing slash marks the path as a directory. Limits are 500 pattern lines and 500 paths of at most 1,000 characters each within 64 KiB of input per box. The tester reads text only: it does not open a repository, run Git, resolve nested .gitignore files, apply .git/info/exclude or core.excludesFile, or consider tracked files.
